findings.title: Federated rule check dropped for the legacy CombinedRule path
findings.body: `useAllAlertRuleAbilities(rule: CombinedRule)` used to compute `isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group)`. It now delegates to `useAllRulerRuleAbilities`, which hardcodes `isFederated = false`. Mimir federated rule groups are therefore no longer treated as immutable. Update, Delete, Pause and Restore become available for them. This hook still backs `useAlertRuleAbility`/`useAlertRuleAbilities` (lines ~180-188), which the non-V2 list and rule viewer use. Those components still call `isFederatedRuleGroup` themselves (RuleViewer.tsx:101, RulesGroup.tsx:61), so the regression is in the shared hook. Keep the federated check in the CombinedRule wrapper, for example by passing it in, or by AND-ing `isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group)` into the result.

findings.title: returnTo parameter dropped from the rule view link
findings.body: The removed `GrafanaRuleListItem` built the href with `createRelativeUrl(..., { returnTo: createReturnTo() })`. The new one omits it. After opening a rule from the list, the viewer can no longer send the user back to the filtered list or location they came from. If this is intentional, say so. Otherwise restore `returnTo`.

findings.title: Tests removed or loosened for behavior that changed
findings.body: The tests for the Creating and Deleting operation states and for `matchRules` were deleted along with the code, so rules that exist only in the ruler or only in Prometheus are no longer covered. The new menu test comment says 'all 4 menu actions' but the assertion list does not include Delete or Pause, and `expect(menuItems.length).toBe(4)` is brittle. Also, `ui.menuItems.delete` is declared but never used.

summary: The main problem is a regression in `useAllAlertRuleAbilities`. It now delegates to a hook that hardcodes `isFederated = false`, so federated Mimir rule groups lose their immutability check. The list view also drops `returnTo` from the rule link, and the new tests are weaker than the ones they replace. I read the changed code and `useIsRuleEditable.ts`, and ran grep searches for `isFederatedRuleGroup` and `useAllAlertRuleAbilities`. I didn't read the other call sites or build or run anything. The `contracts` list is empty because I didn't work through the per-action questions.
